title: Naga into 6 Monks

sources.label: NEW META Rank Up ALL ★★★ 6 Naga + 6 Monks Build | Step By Step Guide

body:
# Naga into 6 Monks

The build that kicked off this whole guide series. It leans on the current
patch's Naga buff (6-piece magic reflection raised from 1.5x to 2x) and
finishes into 6 Monk, anchored by **Largo** — the only unit in the game that
carries both the Naga and Monk tags, making it the natural centerpiece for
this exact pairing.

## Core Units

| Synergy | Units |
| --- | --- |
| Naga (2/4/6) | Largo, Naga Siren, Slardar, Slark, Medusa, Tidehunter |
| Monk (2/4/6) | Largo, Brewmaster, Marci, Monkey King, Void Spirit (or Ringmaster) |

Largo is the anchor: once itemized, it tanks the front line alone while the
rest of the board holds the back row. The 6th Monk slot is flexible — Void
Spirit if available, otherwise Ringmaster (which also carries a Druid tag,
letting it fuse via Lone Druid/Furion/Elder Titan/Enchantress/Treant/Leshrac).

## Draft Priorities

- Tidehunter early is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.
- Ban the **Knights** region — it improves the odds of hitting Naga/Monk
  pieces at tier 2-3.
- Ideally start with something that guarantees the flex Monk slot (e.g.
  Ringmaster plus a Druid piece) so 6 Monk is close to locked in by the
  late game.

## Relics

- **Weighted Dice** and **Lucid Star** are the priority picks — both
  accelerate getting the core to 3-star. Turn off auto-fuse before taking
  Lucid Star, or its free 2-star proc can get auto-consumed instead of
  granted.
- **Second Chance** later unlocks tier-3 rerolls, notably **Aegis of
  Immortal** — an underrated extra-life item, especially on a 3-star Largo.

## Items

- **Tier 2 (early streak)**: win streak into Mask of Madness + Skull Basher
  on an early Slark carry.
- **Tier 4**: Radiance (BiS on Largo), Giants Ring, Pipe of Insight (with
  Naga's reflection active, this makes the team nearly immune to magic).
- **Tier 5**: Mirror Shield if found, Assault Cuirass for armor, Ogre Hood
  or Aeon Disk for survivability. Divine Rapier is situational — it
  underperforms on Largo specifically since this build wins on Monk's
  Drunken Stagger procs rather than raw right-click damage.

## Leveling / Roll Plan

1. **Level 6**: sit and roll until 3-star Largo — the single highest-value
   target in the build. Don't push level 8 early chasing other 3-stars.
2. Once 3-star Largo is secured, push to level 8 (~round 26) and complete
   6 Naga — the reflect buff is the build's biggest power spike.
3. At level 8, roll the rest to 3-star: Slark, Marci, Slardar. 3-star
   Medusa/Rubick are bonus only, not necessary.
4. Add Monkey King and the 6th Monk to complete the Monk synergy.
5. Lategame (~round 51+, level 12): add a 4th Gods piece (Elder Titan, for
   cooldown reduction) as a bonus layer — no further pivot needed.

## Positioning / Matchup Notes

- Once Largo is self-sufficient, put it alone up front; the rest of the
  team holds the back row.
- Naga's reflection covers magic damage; the main lategame risk is
  sustained physical damage, hence the armor items.
- Strong into single right-click carries (out-tanks and out-sustains
  them). Weak into other 6-Monk mirrors with better itemization — those
  fights run long, so having full 3-stars is what wins the war of
  attrition. Pure-damage-heavy comps are the one real hard counter, since
  Naga's reflection doesn't apply to pure damage.
